description:
A storefront designer needs a mock-up of a 3D 'OPEN' sign. Starting from the baseline scene, complete the following:

1. Delete the existing 'BaseCube' to clear the center.
2. Add a Text object (Add > Text) and change the text content to 'OPEN'.
3. In the Text/Font properties, set Geometry > Extrude to 0.15 m.
4. Set Geometry > Bevel > Depth to 0.02 m and Resolution to 3.
5. Position the text at or near the world origin (0,0,0) so it sits on the ground plane.
6. Create a new material for the text with these properties:
   - Base Color: Warm gold tone (approx R=0.8, G=0.55, B=0.1)
   - Metallic: 1.0 (fully metallic)
   - Roughness: Between 0.2 and 0.4
7. Render the scene and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/sign_render.png'.
8. Save the project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/sign_scene.blend'.
